units.source_text: 紫姬说：“故事中所描写的那些浅薄女子，只知模仿别人，教人看了可厌可笑。

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "Those shallow women described in stories only know how to imitate others, and they make people feel both disgusted and amused when they see them.

units.source_text: 只有《空穗物语》中藤原君的女儿，为人稳重直爽，不犯过失。

en.t: Only the daughter of Lord Fujiwara in The Tale of the Hollow Tree is steady and straightforward in character, and does not make mistakes.

units.source_text: 然而过分认真，言行坦率，不像女子模样，也未免太偏差了。”

en.t: Yet she is too earnest, too frank in word and deed, and not very womanly; that too is surely going too far."

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“不但小说中如此，现世也有这样的人。

en.t: Genji replied, "It is not only in novels that this is so; there are people like that in the present world as well.

units.source_text: 这些女子自以为是，与人异趣，难道她不懂得随机应变么？

en.t: Such women think themselves right and deliberately differ from others; can it be that they do not understand how to adapt to circumstances?

units.source_text: 人品高尚的父母悉心教养出来的女儿，只养成了一个天真烂漫的性格，

en.t: When a daughter raised with great care by parents of noble character develops only an innocent and carefree nature,

units.source_text: 此外不如人之处甚多，则旁人就要怀疑她的家庭教育，

en.t: and in many other respects falls short of others, people around her will begin to question her upbringing,

units.source_text: 连她的父母也看不起，实甚遗憾。

en.t: and even look down on her parents, which is truly regrettable.

units.source_text: 反之，女儿长得像模像样，适合她的身份，则父母教养有功，面目光彩。

en.t: On the other hand, if a daughter grows up properly and in a manner suited to her station, then her parents' education has borne fruit, and they gain honor.

units.source_text: 又有些女子，幼时受旁人极口赞誉，而成人之后所做之事，所说之言，

en.t: There are also some women who, when young, were praised extravagantly by others, yet after they grow up, in what they do and what they say,

units.source_text: 全无可观之处，这便是不足道的了。

en.t: there is nothing at all worth seeing; such people are not worth speaking of.

units.source_text: 所以切不可让没见识的人赞誉你的女儿。”

en.t: Therefore, you must never let people without judgment praise your daughter."

units.source_text: 他多方考虑，但愿小女公子将来不受非难。

en.t: He thought the matter over in many ways, hoping only that the young lady would not face criticism in the future.

units.source_text: 记述后母虐待儿女的古代故事，也多得很。

en.t: There are also many old tales that tell of stepmothers mistreating children.

units.source_text: 其中描写后母的狠心，令人看了不快，也不宜教小女公子读。

en.t: Among them, those that portray a stepmother's cruelty make readers uncomfortable, and are not suitable to have the young lady read.

units.source_text: 源氏选择故事非常严格，选定之后，教人抄写清楚，又加插图。

en.t: Genji was very strict in choosing stories; after selecting them, he had people copy them out neatly and add illustrations.
